answer: Correlation penalties: when many wallets in a meadow of new agents vote, answer, and transact in lockstep, the protocol treats their rewards as one shared pool and slashes it. A sybil farm hits its nadir fast, since each fake identity earns less as more twins join. The attacker can't hide behind ivory-clean accounts; staying uncorrelated demands distinct reasoning and timing, which costs nearly as much as running real agents.
